**re: Which CTDL concepts does CTDL publish as corresponding to CEDS values? Group those declared correspondences by predicate, with a few examples each.** The graph holds exactly **53 declared correspondences** from CTDL to CEDS, all sourced from the `ctdlCedsDeclaredCorrespondence` bridge (i.e., CTDL's own published assertions — `mappingKind: authored`). They split across three SKOS/OWL predicates. These are **not mappings** in the match-edge sense: they are published cross-IRI statements that CTDL itself declared. Do not treat them as EXACT/CLOSE/BROAD/NARROW match evidence. --- ## Overview by Predicate | Predicate | Count | What it claims | |---|---|---| | `owl:equivalentClass` | 26 | CTDL and CEDS concepts are fully equivalent classes | | `skos:narrowMatch` | 22 | The CTDL concept is narrower than the CEDS concept | | `skos:relatedMatch` | 5 | The concepts are related but not aligned by generality | | **Total** | **53** | | --- ## `owl:equivalentClass` — 26 assertions CTDL claims full class equivalence. The subject matter is almost entirely **financial aid award types** — CTDL's `financialAid:` concept scheme maps one-to-one onto CEDS option values from the Financial Aid Award Type option set (OS000113) and the Financial Aid Veteran's Benefit Type set (OS001610). | CTDL Concept | CTDL URI | CEDS Value | CEDS ID | |---|---|---|---| | Pell Grant | `financialAid:PellGrant` | Pell grants | OV000113116518 | | Federal Subsidized Loan | `financialAid:FederalSubsidizedLoan` | Federal subsidized loans | OV000113115736 | | Federal Unsubsidized Loan | `financialAid:FederalUnsubsidizedLoan` | Federal unsubsidized loans | OV000113115737 | | Federal Work Study | `financialAid:FederalWorkStudy` | Federal work study | OV000113115738 | | Parent PLUS Loan | `financialAid:ParentPLUSLoan` | Parent PLUS loans | OV000113116484 | | Institutional Grant | `financialAid:InstitutionalGrant` | Institutional grants | OV000113115936 | | Private Scholarship | `financialAid:PrivateScholarship` | Private scholarships | OV000113116612 | | Academic Assistantship | `financialAid:AcademicAssistantship` | Assistantships | OV000113115284 | | Dept. of Defense Tuition Assistance | `financialAid:DoDTuitionAssistance` | Department of Defense Tuition Assistance | OV001610115588 | | Post 9-11 GI Bill | `financialAid:Post911GIBill` | Post-9/11 GI Bill | OV001610116566 | | General Financial Assistance | `financialAid:General` | Financial Aid Award Type *(the option set itself)* | OS000113 | | Military | `financialAid:Military` | Financial Aid Veteran's Benefit Type *(the option set itself)* | OS001610 | | … | … | … | … | > Note: Two of the `owl:equivalentClass` assertions target the CEDS **option set** nodes themselves (OS000113, OS001610) — CTDL's general/military umbrella concepts pointing to the entire CEDS enumeration as a class. --- ## `skos:narrowMatch` — 22 assertions CTDL claims its concept is **narrower** (more specific) than the CEDS value. These all come from CTDL's `support:` concept scheme — **learner support services** — mapped to CEDS option values under the support services option set (OS000273). | CTDL Concept | CTDL URI | CEDS Value (broader) | CEDS ID | |---|---|---|---| | Assistive Technology Support | `support:AssistiveTechnologySupport` | Assistive technology services | OV000273172830 | | Behavioral Service | `support:BehavioralService` | Behavior and Behavioral Consultation Service | OV000273172851 | | Mental Health Counseling | `support:MentalHealthCounseling` | Mental health counseling | OV000273172812 | | Neurodivergence Service | `support:NeurodivergenceService` | Autism Spectrum Disorder Service | OV000273172843 | | Supported Work | `support:SupportedWork` | Supported employment services | OV000273172786 | | Tutoring | `support:Tutoring` | Tutoring services | OV000273172825 | | Vision Service | `support:VisionService` | Vision services | OV000273172826 | | Transportation | `support:Transportation` | Transportation services | OV000273172788 | | Transportation | `support:Transportation` | Special transportation | OV000273172805 | | Sign Language | `support:SignLanguage` | Individual career education | OV000273172837 | > Notable: `support:Transportation` has **two** `skos:narrowMatch` targets in CEDS (both "Transportation services" and "Special transportation"), and `support:SignLanguage` maps to the unexpected CEDS value "Individual career education" — a somewhat indirect correspondence. --- ## `skos:relatedMatch` — 5 assertions CTDL claims a related but non-hierarchical correspondence. All five are also from the `support:` scheme, and represent cases where the concepts are in the same domain but can't be cleanly placed as broader/narrower. | CTDL Concept | CTDL URI | CEDS Value | CEDS ID | |---|---|---|---| | Audiological Health Care | `support:AudiologicalHealthCare` | Audiological services | OV000273172828 | | Case Management | `support:CaseManagement` | Case management services | OV000273172809 | | Public Benefits Case Management | `support:PublicBenefitsCaseManagement` | Service coordination (case management services) | OV000273172834 | | Immigration Assistance | `support:ImmigrationAssistance` | Behavior and Behavioral Consultation Service | OV000273172851 | | Translation | `support:Translation` | Translation/interpreter services | OV000273172824 | > `support:ImmigrationAssistance` → "Behavior and Behavioral Consultation Service" stands out as a loose correspondence — CTDL itself marked it only `skos:relatedMatch`, signaling the relationship is weak. --- ## Summary Pattern The declared correspondences divide neatly by **domain**: - **Financial aid types** (`financialAid:` scheme) → `owl:equivalentClass` against CEDS Financial Aid Award Type and Veteran's Benefit Type values — these are tight, parallel enumerations. - **Learner support services** (`support:` scheme) → `skos:narrowMatch` or `skos:relatedMatch` against CEDS support service values — CTDL's taxonomy is more granular than CEDS' in several places (e.g. splitting transportation, expanding autism/neurodivergence), and a handful of looser pairings warranted `relatedMatch` rather than a directional claim.
